events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_partial $15.22 (model confidence 0.86)
events.body:
This is a RydeTAXI trip billed on the meter, so fare scales with distance and any unjustified extra kilometres are chargeable error, not a fixed-quote matter [F5][F7][RD-2]. Two off-route segments are recorded: 21:46–21:56 adding 6.94 km and 22:04–22:13 adding 3.85 km, giving the +11.6 km / +73% total over the 15.9 km optimal route [F1][F3][F4]. Under RD-1 each segment is reviewed separately and, absent an exemption, is a non-exempt deviation; nothing in the record exempts either one [F3][F4][RD-1].

The driver's reasonable-cause defence does not hold. The only traffic incident is an accident reported 21:26 on the Kallang Paya Lebar Expressway located 0 m from the optimal route, i.e. on the stretch being avoided, while no incident is shown on the stretch actually replaced; segment F3 runs up to 2240 m off the optimal route, well outside any matching to the replaced stretch [F3][F10][F13][RD-4]. The speed bands are KPE band 5 (40–49 km/h) and PIE band 4 (30–39 km/h) — normal flowing traffic, above the band-2 (10–19 km/h) threshold — so they corroborate nothing and cannot exempt on their own [F11][F12][RD-4]. Weather was fair, excluding any weather reason [F14][RD-4].

Neither does the rider's own conduct exempt the detour. The chats show only pickup logistics, with no driver request for a route change before leaving the optimal route and no rider agreement, so RD-5 is not satisfied for either segment [F8][F9][RD-5]. No rider-named stop or in-app stop request appears, so RD-3 does not apply, and RD-3(b) is not invoked because this is a driver-proposed route, not a rider stop request [F8][F9][RD-3].

Amount: only the extra kilometres of the non-exempt segments are recoverable, priced at the trip's per-km rate derived from the fare itself — distance fare $38.80 ÷ distance 27.5 km = $1.4099/km [F7][RD-2]. Non-exempt extra km = 6.94 + 3.85 = 10.79 km [F3][F4]. 10.79 km × $1.4099/km = $15.2128 → $15.22 [F3][F4][F7][RD-2]. The residual difference against the billed excess of $16.41 is the ≤0.25 km map-matching remainder and is not refunded; waiting was $0.00 and platform fee $1.47 is a published charge, so nothing else is recoverable [F5][F7][RD-2].

Driver's profile shows 447 trips in 90 days with 1 upheld dispute but route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0, so the RD-6 repeated-breach condition is not met and no account flag is added; the fact that both segments are upheld stands on the GPS record alone, not on profile [F15][F16][RD-6].

ruling.recommended_action: Refund $15.22 to the rider as a Ryde voucher (RD-2 metered refund for the two non-exempt off-route segments); record the driver's RD-1 shortest-route breach. No account flag — driver's route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0 (F16), so RD-6's repeated-breach condition is not met.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's reasonable-cause defence (driver statement F10) fails: the only incident, F13, is 0 m from the optimal route on KPE and the plan was to go round it, so there is no incident on the replaced stretch as RD-4(a) requires, and the speed bands 5 and 4 in F11/F12 are above band 2 and cannot exempt alone under RD-4(b).

segment_findings.reason: No exemption applies: no rider-named stop was requested (RD-3), the traffic incident F13 sits on KPE while this segment runs up to 2240 m off the optimal route, exceeding the 300 m matching radius, so it is not shown to be on the replaced stretch (RD-4(a)); F11/F12 report KPE and PIE at speed bands 5 and 4, both above band 2, so they do not corroborate congestion (RD-4(b)); and no driver request with prior rider agreement appears in the chat (F8, F9) (RD-5). Segment stands as a non-exempt deviation under RD-1.

Same review: no rider stop request or prior agreed route change (RD-3, RD-5); the F13 accident is not tied to this replaced stretch (RD-4(a)); the KPE/PIE speed bands 5 and 4 (F11, F12) are far above the band-2 threshold and are corroborative only at best (RD-4(b)).
